'''menace64 Ahhhh, the invasion deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[menace64]]
* '''Published:''' 7 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion menace64 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

the good old walk all over you opponent deck!

The published list has 67 cards.
